mapper.sql: s.id, s.scene_code, s.scene_name, s.description, s.flow_id, f.flow_code, s.published_version_id, v.version_number AS published_version_number, s.updatetime
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_scene s JOIN tb_flow f ON f.id = s.flow_id AND f.isactive = 1 LEFT JOIN tb_flow_version v ON v.id = s.published_version_id AND v.isactive = 1 WHERE s.scene_code = #{sceneCode} AND s.isactive = 1

SELECT FROM tb_scene s JOIN tb_flow f ON f.id = s.flow_id AND f.isactive = 1 LEFT JOIN tb_flow_version v ON v.id = s.published_version_id AND v.isactive = 1 WHERE s.isactive = 1 AND (s.scene_code LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR s.scene_name LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!') ORDER BY s.updatetime DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_scene s WHERE s.isactive = 1 AND (s.scene_code LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR s.scene_name LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!')
SELECT published_version_id FROM tb_scene WHERE scene_code = #{sceneCode} AND isactive = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_scene SET published_version_id = #{newId} WHERE scene_code = #{sceneCode} AND isactive = 1 AND ((published_version_id IS NULL AND #{expectedId,jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL) OR published_version_id = #{expectedId,jdbcType=BIGINT}) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_flow_draft d WHERE d.flow_id = tb_scene.flow_id AND d.revision = #{expectedRevision} AND d.isactive = 1)
